##### Project general facts

The Crest is a visionary residential development within the prestigious Sobha Hartland community, featuring Caribbean-style crystal lagoon-facing residences with interlinked sky gardens. This experiential community offers a lifestyle worthy of every day, with no reason to step out. Featuring a collection of one, two, and three-bedroom apartments, The Crest is where escaping is staying, offering residents the perks of living by a crystal lagoon in central Dubai.

Residents enjoy a comprehensive range of indoor and outdoor amenities designed to enhance daily living. Indoor facilities include a multipurpose hall, spin class studio, Pilates studio, and yoga studio. Outdoor amenities feature a kids' play area, outdoor gym terrace, tai chi terrace, and beautifully landscaped terraces at different levels with a host of amenities. Every element is crafted to create a community where residents can thrive, relax, and connect.

Every residence at The Crest features modern finishing with high-quality materials, fully equipped kitchens, and thoughtfully designed layouts that maximize space and natural light. The interiors reflect a commitment to quality and contemporary living, creating homes that are both stylish and functional. The crystal lagoon views and sky garden connections add an extra dimension to the living experience, making each home a sanctuary of comfort and elegance.

##### Location description and benefits 

Nestled in the epicentre of the city within Sobha Hartland, this exceptional location offers residents views of the Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary and the crystal lagoon, with major landmarks just minutes away. The community features two international schools, three lush green parks connected by a central pathway, and acres of green canopies that surround residents in this exclusive setting.

The location is distinguished by its strategic positioning and abundant green spaces. Central Park offers acres of green canopies, Greens East Park provides outdoor recreation with an amphitheater, kids' play area, and rock-climbing wall, while Greens West Park brings the forest to your doorstep — a doorway to a world far away, yet in the centre of the city. The community's thoughtful planning ensures residents enjoy a balanced lifestyle with everything they need within easy reach.

For those seeking a residence that embodies experiential living, community connection, and a prime Dubai address, Sobha Hartland delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of crystal lagoon living, lush green spaces, and strategic connectivity makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of city living.
